sys_script.description: The script cancels the flow execution of the SLA reminder task for an outbound email record
sys_script.message:
var flowContext = new GlideRecord('sys_flow_context');//for defect MSSRBX-1055, MSSRBX-1064
    flowContext.addQuery('source_record', current.sys_id);
    flowContext.query();
    while(flowContext.next()){
        sn_fd.FlowAPI.cancel(flowContext.getUniqueValue(), 'Cancelling in-progress flows for cancelled trade task');//MSSRBXSN-3363
    }
sys_script.name: HSBC - Cancel SLA flow execution
